items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Basie Gillens as a young man in Omaha who heard stories about the interviewee (Ernie Fields) and Basie, but the interviewee does not describe a direct personal interaction or relationship with Basie Gillens.

ctx.x: In fact, a young man that's here now in Omaha, Basie Gillens, he was saying that long ago he would hear some of the guys talking and said anybody that come from that area, and especially when they would get to talking about money--none of us were making anything that amounted to anything, we got ten or twelve dollars guaranteed, and we were happy if that

was guaranteed for a night, but some of them would even take that and Basie said before he knew me and everything, some of the guys would say, well, let's try Ernie, and somebody who had been in the band would say, well, that's one thing about him, he'll be fair with you and make you feel you.
